item.name: Stateless personalised feed (no candidate record required)

request.name: Stateless personalised feed (no candidate record required)

description.content:
Returns a ranked AI/ML news feed personalised by the signals in
the request body. We do **not** persist any part of the body —
no candidate is created, no PII is stored. Designed for serving
a feed to every developer on your platform without uploading
their profiles to us.

Pass as little or as much as you want:
- `preferences.topics` only → topic-filtered feed
- `profile.ai_ml.domain_specializations` → domain-aligned
- Full profile + preferences → maximum personalisation
- Empty body → recency-only feed

Same item shape, same ranking formula, same `image_url`
thumbnails as the candidate-scoped endpoint.

> Renamed from `POST /v1/feed/recommend` on 2026-05-15. The old
> URL still works through 2026-06-15 but returns the standard
> `Deprecation: true` / `Sunset` / `Link` headers.

B2B API for AI-powered hiring. Resume PDFs into structured profiles,
job descriptions into scoring rubrics, candidate × job matches with
evidence, plus a personalized AI/ML news feed per candidate. Every
authenticated call is billed and tracked (see GET /v1/usage/summary).

**Base URL (production):** https://aiwire-api.aiwire.workers.dev

**Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_<your-key>` on every /v1/* call.
Your key resolves to a workspace; all resources are scoped to that workspace.

**Errors:** RFC 7807 Problem Details with `Aiwire-Request-Id` header on
every response (success or failure). Include the request ID in support
emails.

**Rate limit:** 100 requests / minute per key. Hit a 429? Wait the
`Retry-After` seconds.
